Branch-Oriented Seniors.description: higher age; lower mobile-app usage, app logins, transaction frequency

actions.low: No contact. Offer help to use digital services at the next branch visit.
actions.medium: Friendly call or letter from the branch; guided digital onboarding.
actions.high: Personal call from the branch relationship manager within one week; priority service line and fee review.

High-Balance Savers.description: higher balance; lower number of products, age, transaction frequency

actions.medium: Relationship-manager check-in; competitive savings or investment offer.
actions.high: Priority call by a senior relationship manager; bespoke retention offer protecting the balance.

Digital Power Users.description: higher transaction frequency, spending, app logins; lower age, days since last transaction

actions.low: No contact. Keep monitoring; cross-sell through in-app offers.
actions.medium: In-app nudge or cashback on their favourite spending category; avoid costly discounts.
actions.high: Alert the digital-engagement team: personalised in-app offer and a short survey about what changed.

Everyday Low-Balance Users.description: higher number of products; lower balance

actions.low: No contact; promote savings goals in the app.
actions.medium: Low-cost automated offer: fee waiver or salary-deposit bonus.
actions.high: Review products and fees (many products, low balance); proactive complaint resolution; simplify the product bundle.

Dormant & Fading.description: higher days since last transaction, age; lower recent activity trend, transaction frequency, spending

actions.medium: Reactivation campaign with a simple first action (e.g. set up a direct debit) and a small incentive.
actions.high: Immediate outbound contact: understand the reason, resolve open complaints, offer a targeted win-back incentive.
